-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create role "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r" with nosuperuser nocreatedb nocreaterole inherit nologin;

-- action: ddl

create role "okm_recreate_mig_smgzvcqk" with nosuperuser nocreatedb nocreaterole inherit nologin;

-- kind: grant-default

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-extension
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create extension "citext" schema "public";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-extension
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create extension "pg_trgm" schema "public";

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-enum
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create type "public"."color" as enum ('red', 'blue');

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-domain
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create domain "public"."label" as text constraint "label_check" check (((length(VALUE) > 0)));

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."items" (
  "email" text not null,
  "heading" text not null,
  "id" bigint generated always as identity not null,
  "label" label not null,
  "note" text,
  "status" color not null,
  "userId" integer,
  constraint "items_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."items" add constraint "items_emailPresent_check" check (((email <> ''::text)));

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."items" add constraint "items_email_key" unique ("email");

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE
create unique index "items_email_idx" on "public"."items" ("email");

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE
create index "items_heading_idx" on "public"."items" using gin ("heading" gin_trgm_ops);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE
create index "items_note_idx" on "public"."items" using gist ("note" gist_trgm_ops);

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE
create index "items_userId_idx" on "public"."items" ("userId");

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-table
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create table "public"."users" (
  "email" text not null,
  "id" integer not null,
  "taskId" bigint,
  constraint "users_pkey" primary key ("id")
);

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."items" add constraint "items_userId_fkey" foreign key ("userId") references "public"."users" ("id");

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."users" add constraint "users_email_key" unique ("email");

-- class: expand
-- kind: add-constraint
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
alter table "public"."users" add constraint "users_taskId_fkey" foreign key ("taskId") references "public"."items" ("id");

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-function
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create function "public"."touch_title"() returns trigger language plpgsql volatile security invoker as $okm$begin return new; end$okm$;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-trigger
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create trigger "tasks_touch" before update on "public"."items" for each row execute function "public"."touch_title"();

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-view
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create view "public"."task_rows" as SELECT id,
    heading
   FROM items;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-matview
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
create materialized view "public"."task_titles" as SELECT id,
    heading
   FROM items with no data;

-- class: expand
-- kind: create-index
-- action: ddl
-- lock: SHARE
create unique index "task_titles_id_idx" on "public"."task_titles" ("id");

-- class: expand
-- kind: refresh-matview
-- action: backfill
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
refresh materialized view "public"."task_titles";

-- class: contract
-- kind: revoke
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
revoke execute on function "public"."touch_title"() from public;

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant execute on function "public"."touch_title"() to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on table "public"."task_titles" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

-- class: contract

-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
revoke insert, update, delete on table "public"."task_titles" from "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on sequence "public"."items_id_seq" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

-- class: expand

-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant usage on sequence "public"."items_id_seq" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

grant delete on table "public"."items" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

grant delete on table "public"."users" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

grant insert on table "public"."users" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on table "public"."users" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

-- class: expand
-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant update on table "public"."users" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant delete on table "public"."task_rows" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant insert on table "public"."task_rows" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

-- kind: grant
-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant select on table "public"."task_rows" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

-- class: expand

-- action: ddl
-- lock: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
grant update on table "public"."task_rows" to "okm_recreate_app_vgjbzd2r";

alter table "public"."users" add constraint "users_taskId_fkey" foreign key ("taskId") references "public"."items" ("id")
